blurb: This control verifies that the DHCP server daemon (dhcpsd) is not configured to start at boot when the host is not required to serve DHCP. DISA STIG V-215405 states the rule as a prohibition: running the check command must yield no output at all. If a "start /usr/sbin/dhcpsd" line is present in /etc/rc.tcpip, the system boots a service that hands out IP addresses and network configuration, letting a rogue client or an attacker redirect traffic or hand out conflicting addresses.
